general_idle_time.description: Seconds of inactivity before triggering suspension (replaces 'timeout')

general_suspend_cmd.description: Command to execute for suspending the system

general_wakeup_cmd.description: Command to set up scheduled wake-up alarm before suspending

general_woke_up_file.description: Path to file indicating system just woke up (used to suppress immediate resuspension)

general_lock_file.description: Path to lock file to prevent concurrent invocations

general_lock_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for lock before giving up

check_Ping_enabled.description: Whether to enable the Ping-based activity check

check_Ping_hosts.description: Space-separated list of hosts to ping for network activity detection

check_Smb_enabled.description: Whether to enable the SMB-based activity check

check_RemoteUsers_enabled.description: Whether to enable the custom RemoteUsers activity check

check_RemoteUsers_name.description: Regex pattern for usernames to consider in RemoteUsers check

check_RemoteUsers_terminal.description: Regex pattern for terminal types to consider in RemoteUsers check

check_RemoteUsers_host.description: Regex pattern for remote host patterns to consider in RemoteUsers check

check_LocalUsers_enabled.description: Whether to enable the custom LocalUsers activity check

check_LocalUsers_name.description: Regex pattern for usernames to consider in LocalUsers check

check_LocalUsers_terminal.description: Regex pattern for terminal types to consider in LocalUsers check

check_LocalUsers_host.description: Regex pattern for host patterns to consider in LocalUsers check

wakeup_Calendar_enabled.description: Whether to enable the calendar-based wake-up check

wakeup_Calendar_url.description: URL of calendar file (e.g., iCal) for scheduled wake-ups
